purpose: Observe systems-engineering task completion, judgment, source fidelity, source-preserving change work, and proportionate routing across every shipped skill. Descriptive smoke coverage, not a causal skill-effect estimate.
source_state: uncommitted candidate; packet hashes bind actual inputs
producer_access: Only own prepared packet(s), supplied skill references, relevant accessible primary sources when explicitly needed. No repository, reviews, prior outputs, or other arms. Shared host still exposes global metadata; isolation is instruction based, not enforced.
assessment: Independent reviewer after production; per criterion 0 missing/contradicted,1 partial/consequential gap,2 coherent and supported; located findings and repair effort. Review proposed rubrics too.
critical_failure_categories: loss of protected input wording or IDs
unsupported source/regulatory claims presented as established
release_rule: Any critical error blocks the associated behavioral quality claim and triggers targeted repair plus fresh case reassessment. No aggregate score authorizes general superiority. Maintain complete outcomes and failures.
metadata: Exact inherited model/settings/tokens/cost may be unavailable; record unknown and observed times, never infer. Multiple cases in one agent context are correlated.
preproduction_correction: Independent review corrected Flight1549 locator and made HO04 serial-path rubric conditional before any producer was launched. Earlier unexecuted preparation retained.
